values.note: 2026: primitive camping $20 a night, one rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split). Mecosta County Parks vehicle permits are not required at Haymarsh.

fees.source: https://www.mecostacountyparks.com/uploads/9/2/6/3/92633552/2026_rate_card.pdf (2026 rate card: 'Haymarsh State Game Area Campground ... Primitive Camping $20') + https://www.mecostacountyparks.com/haymarsh-lake.html ('Mecosta County Parks vehicle permits are not required at Haymarsh Lake Campground'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Pay at the campground registration station by cash or check.

booking.source: https://www.mecostacountyparks.com/haymarsh-lake.html ('Haymarsh Lake Campground is first come, first served and does not allow reservations. Payments are accepted at the campground registration station via cash or check.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 19 rustic campsites, each with a picnic table and fire pit, plus a group tent camping section (contact the parks office). No length limit posted.

sites.source: https://www.mecostacountyparks.com/haymarsh-lake.html ('Haymarsh Campground offers 19 rustic campsites plus a group tent camping section', 'Each Campsite contains a picnic table and fire pit'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Hand water pump, two boat launches, fish cleaning station, trash dumpster.

facilities.source: https://www.mecostacountyparks.com/haymarsh-lake.html (Amenities: 'Rustic Waterfront Camping, Public Hunting Land Access, 2 Boat Launches, Vault Toilets, Hand Water Pump, Fish Cleaning Station, Trash Dumpster'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Mecosta County Parks campground on Haymarsh Lake (375 acres, a 1949 flooding that joined six small lakes) within the DNR's 6,737-acre Haymarsh Lake State Game Area, ~7 mi E of Paris; public hunting land access. Open ~May-Dec 1. Max RV length not published -- sites described as spacious, but firsthand big-rig confirmation lacking. --Claude
summary: County page + 2026 rate card: $20 primitive camping (2026, no non-resident rate), first-come only with cash/check self-registration, 19 rustic sites + group tent area, vault toilets, hand pump, two boat launches (fees new; rest confirmed). Season not stated (derived not-year-round left). Phone (231) 832-3246 matches the parks administrative office. Note trimmed of field restatements and the RV Life line.
